## Motivation

With DP attention, GLM-5.2's DSA indexer computes paged MQA FP8 logits with aiter's gluon kernel (`aiter.ops.triton.pa_mqa_logits.deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits`, preshuffled cache). On gfx950 it runs for decode / MTP-verify batches above the 48 rows that the fused gfx950 indexer takes, and for MTP draft-extend rows. At 48 to 84 rows that kernel takes 272 to 310 us per call against aiter main 6fe1bfc. This PR adds an in-tree retuned version of it that takes 93 to 97 us on the same inputs, about 3x faster.

## Modifications

- **New `kernels/ops/attention/dsa/gluon_paged_mqa_logits.py`.** It is derived from aiter's `_gluon_deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits_preshuffle` and its host wrapper (aiter e7d2453). It is reduced to the path sglang takes here (gfx950, preshuffled 64-token pages, 32 heads x 128, one query per row) and retuned:
  - **KV split.** The split is decoupled from the occupancy hint and set from the row count. Program ids are swizzled so that the pieces of one row share an XCD and its L2.
  - **Dispatch order.** MTP verify rows of one request (6 consecutive rows) are dispatched longest group first.
  - **Pair kernel.** `_gluon_paged_mqa_logits_fused2` scores two adjacent rows per program when their page tables match on their common prefix, so their K pages are read once. The match is checked on the device; rows that do not match are scored separately, so any input is exact.
  - **gfx950 instructions.** Full-rate scaled fp8 MFMA, a uniform (SGPR) row index, and `relu` as one `v_maximum3`.
- **Dispatch.** `paged_mqa_logits.aiter_paged_mqa_logits` calls it when `gluon_paged_mqa_logits.supported()` holds: gfx950, preshuffled, page 64, 32 x 128, 1 to 128 rows. Otherwise it calls aiter as before. If gluon cannot be imported, aiter is used.
- **No new flags.**
- **Tests** (`test/registered/amd/test_dsa_gluon_paged_mqa_logits.py`) compare against aiter's kernel. They check equality to fp32 rounding on every valid column, and that the top-2048 selection differs only within that rounding. Inputs:
  - 48- to 126-row MTP batches with shared tables;
  - paired rows whose tables differ;
  - plain decode with 1, 7, 48, 100 and 128 rows.

## Accuracy Tests

- **Logits.** Differences from aiter come only from summation order: max |diff| is 7.6e-6.
- **Top-k sets.** On real GLM-5.2 workset indices (48 to 84 rows, contexts up to 659k), v1 top-k gives the same top-k sets from either logits.
- **gsm8k.** GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8 DP8 DP-attention, MTP with acceptance not simulated, 400 questions, fresh server per run, alternating:

| | gsm8k |
|---|---|
| main (5 servers) | 0.943 / 0.945 / 0.932 / 0.930 / 0.920 (mean 0.934) |
| this PR (6 servers) | 0.920 / 0.917 / 0.925 / 0.920 / 0.945 / 0.932 (mean 0.927) |

The ranges overlap. The difference in means is within the run-to-run spread of this setup.

**A bug in the source kernel's pair path, fixed here.** In the derived kernel, each split decided between the pair pass and the two single-row passes from the page ids in its own window. The two branches partition the context differently, so when two adjacent rows had different tables and different lengths, the shorter row's tail went unwritten. This happens in plain decode with 48 rows, for example. MTP siblings never hit it. The decision now uses the whole common prefix, so all splits of a pair agree. The plain-decode test covers this case.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

**Kernel.** On MI355X:
- inputs: real GLM-5.2 verify rows (6 per request), page table 16386 pages wide (the captured graph width);
- one CUDA graph runs the call over 4 index-K pools of 294 MB each;
- medians in us per call.

| rows (real GLM-5.2 verify rows) | longest context | aiter main | this PR | speedup |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 48 | 462k | 276.5 | 103.7 | 2.67x |
| 60 | 385k | 273.2 | 101.7 | 2.69x |
| 72 | 433k | 312.4 | 102.2 | 3.06x |
| 84 | 429k | 290.2 | 104.3 | 2.78x |

The speedup grows with context. In-server (eager, 96 rows per rank, about 16k-token contexts, torch profiler) the call takes 26.2 us against aiter's 32.5 us (1.24x).

**End to end.**
- Setup: GLM-5.2-MXFP4, TP8 DP8 with DP attention, MTP (EAGLE 5 / 1 / 6), simulated acceptance 3.61, `--max-running-requests 128 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 16`. That is 16 requests and 96 verify rows per rank, which is this kernel's range.
- Benchmark: `bench_serving`, random 32k input / 1k output, concurrency 128.
- Main and this PR alternate on one node, fresh server each.

| | median ITL ms |
|---|---|
| main (3 servers, 6 runs) | 13.93 - 13.95 |
| this PR (3 servers, 6 runs) | 13.79 - 13.81 |

That is 0.9% lower median ITL. At 32k contexts this kernel is a small share of the step; the per-call speedup is largest at long contexts (table above).

## How to reproduce

```bash
python3 test/registered/amd/test_dsa_gluon_paged_mqa_logits.py -v     # one gfx950 GPU
SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.61 SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=real-draft-token \
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \
  --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --data-parallel-size 8 --enable-dp-attention --max-running-requests 128 --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 16
python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 32000 --random-output-len 1000 \
  --random-range-ratio 1.0 --num-prompts 256 --max-concurrency 128
```

The kernel changes were found with an automated kernel-optimization search on top of aiter's kernel. This PR ports them into sglang, fixes the pair-path bug above, and adds the dispatch gate and tests. They could equally move into aiter's own kernel later.

@@ -0,0 +1,2022 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+# Copyright (C) 2024-2026, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. All rights reserved.
+"""gfx950 paged MQA FP8 logits for the DSA indexer (decode / MTP verify rows).
+
+Derived from aiter's gluon ``_gluon_deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits_preshuffle``
+(aiter/ops/triton/gluon/pa_mqa_logits.py, aiter e7d2453) and its host wrapper,
+reduced to the path sglang takes here (gfx950, preshuffled 64-token pages,
+32 heads x 128, one query per row) and re-tuned:
+
+- the KV split is decoupled from the occupancy hint and set per row count, and
+  program ids are swizzled so that the pieces of one row share an XCD (L2);
+- MTP verify rows of one request (6 consecutive rows) are dispatched longest
+  group first;
+- ``_gluon_paged_mqa_logits_fused2`` scores two sibling rows per program when
+  their page tables match (checked on the device, so any input is exact);
+- gfx950's full-rate scaled fp8 MFMA, a uniform-SGPR row index, and ``relu``
+  as one ``v_maximum3``.
+
+Only ``paged_mqa_logits.aiter_paged_mqa_logits`` calls into this module, and
+only when :func:`supported` holds; every other shape keeps aiter's kernel.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from functools import cache
+
+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl
+from triton.experimental import gluon
+from triton.experimental.gluon import language as gl
+
+
+@cache
+def _gfx() -> str:
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName.split(":")[0]
+
+
+def get_cdna_version() -> int:
+    """4 on gfx950 (CDNA4), 3 on gfx942 (CDNA3), -1 otherwise."""
+    gfx = _gfx()
+    return 4 if gfx.startswith("gfx95") else (3 if gfx.startswith("gfx94") else -1)
+
+
+def get_gfx() -> str:
+    return _gfx()
+
+
+@cache
+def get_num_sms() -> int:
+    return torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).multi_processor_count
+
+
+# Number of XCDs the phase-1 grid is round-robined over (gfx950 SPX = 8).
+# Used to relabel program ids so that the KV-split pieces that share page-table
+# entries land on the same XCD and hit its private L2 instead of the fabric.
+_NUM_XCD = tl.constexpr(8)
+
+try:
+    from triton.experimental.gluon.language.amd.cdna3 import (
+        s_set_prio as _amd_s_set_prio,
+    )
+    from triton.experimental.gluon.language.amd.cdna3 import (
+        sched_barrier as _amd_iglp_sched_barrier,
+    )
+    from triton.experimental.gluon.language.amd.cdna3 import (
+        sched_group_barrier as _amd_iglp_sched_group_barrier,
+    )
+except ImportError:
+    # ignore iglp hint
+    @gluon.jit
+    def _amd_iglp_sched_barrier(inst_mask):
+        pass
+
+    @gluon.jit
+    def _amd_iglp_sched_group_barrier(inst_mask, cnt, _):
+        pass
+
+    @gluon.jit
+    def _amd_s_set_prio(prio):
+        pass
+
+
+# for some newer triton>=3.5 version, a 3D instr_shape is required.
+try:
+    _cdna_version = get_cdna_version()
+    _version = _cdna_version if _cdna_version > 0 else 3
+    _: gl.constexpr = gl.amd.AMDMFMALayout(
+        version=_version,
+        instr_shape=[16, 16],
+        transposed=False,
+        warps_per_cta=[1, 1],
+        tiles_per_warp=[1, 1],
+    )
+    _Use_2d_instr_shape_mfma_layout = tl.constexpr(True)
+except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
+    _Use_2d_instr_shape_mfma_layout = tl.constexpr(False)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _sum_combine(a, b):
+    return a + b
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _uniform_i32(x):
+    # v_readfirstlane into an SGPR ("=s" output): the value is then provably uniform, so
+    # buffer descriptors / loop bounds derived from it stay scalar (no waterfall loops).
+    # The s_nops cover the VALU/DPP-write -> readfirstlane-read and the VALU-SGPR-write ->
+    # use hazards, which the compiler cannot see through inline asm (without the leading
+    # nop the read returned a stale lane value, measured).
+    return gl.inline_asm_elementwise(
+        "s_nop 4\n v_readfirstlane_b32 $0, $1\n s_nop 4",
+        "=s,v",
+        [x],
+        dtype=gl.int32,
+        is_pure=True,
+        pack=1,
+    )
+
+
+@gluon.jit
+def _dot_fp8(a, b, acc, CDNA_VERSION: gl.constexpr):
+    # gfx950: the full-rate v_mfma_*_f8f6f4 instructions are only reachable through the
+    # scaled-MFMA op (plain tt.dot has no fp8 mapping for K=64/128 shapes); unit e8m0
+    # scales (0x7F == 2^0) make it a plain fp8 dot. The legacy v_mfma_f32_16x16x32_fp8
+    # runs at half of gfx950's fp8 rate (16 cycles each, measured).
+    # Epilogue relu: gl.maximum(.., propagate_nan=ALL) lowers to one v_maximum3_f32 per
+    # element; the default maxnum form costs a canonicalize v_max plus the v_max.
+    # Bitwise identical for finite inputs; a NaN MFMA output (only from fp8 NaN codes,
+    # which the ue8m0 cache writer does not produce from finite K) now propagates
+    # instead of being clipped to 0.
+    if CDNA_VERSION == 4:
+        out = gl.amd.cdna4.mfma_scaled(a, None, "e4m3", b, None, "e4m3", acc)
+    else:
+        out = gl.amd.cdna3.mfma(a, b, acc)
+    return out
+
+
+# ===========================================================================
+# Device side: the preshuffle kernel (aiter e7d2453 + the changes listed in the module docstring)
+# ===========================================================================
+@gluon.jit
+def _gluon_deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits_preshuffle(
+    batch_size,
+    next_n,
+    heads_num,
+    Q_buffer,
+    stride_q_batch,
+    stride_q_next_n,
+    stride_q_heads,
+    KV_buffer,
+    stride_k_seq,
+    scale_buffer,
+    stride_scale_seq,
+    context_len_ptr,
+    kv_indices,
+    weights,
+    stride_w_batch,
+    OutLogits_buffer,
+    stride_out_batch,
+    max_model_len,
+    max_block_len,
+    num_block,
+    SplitKV: gl.constexpr,
+    ChunkQ: gl.constexpr,
+    ChunkK: gl.constexpr,
+    HiddenDim: gl.constexpr,
+    KVBlockSize: gl.constexpr = 16,
+    CDNA_VERSION: gl.constexpr = 3,
+    ARCH: gl.constexpr = "gfx942",
+    LPT_GROUP: gl.constexpr = 0,
+    NG2: gl.constexpr = 16,
+):
+    IS_GFX1250: gl.constexpr = ARCH == "gfx1250"
+    # ===---------------------------------------------------
+    # Gluon Layout
+    # ===---------------------------------------------------
+    if IS_GFX1250:
+        NumWarps: gl.constexpr = 1
+    else:
+        NumWarps: gl.constexpr = 4
+    ThreadsPerWarp: gl.constexpr = 32 if IS_GFX1250 else 64
+
+    ValQMPerThread: gl.constexpr = ChunkQ // (
+        NumWarps * ThreadsPerWarp // (HiddenDim // 16)
+    )
+    layout_q: gl.constexpr = gl.BlockedLayout(
+        size_per_thread=[ValQMPerThread, 16],  # q type is fp8 (E4M3)
+        threads_per_warp=[ThreadsPerWarp // (HiddenDim // 16), HiddenDim // 16],
+        warps_per_cta=[NumWarps, 1],
+        order=[1, 0],
+    )
+
+    if IS_GFX1250:
+        ChunkKPerStage: gl.constexpr = 16
+    else:
+        ChunkKPerStage: gl.constexpr = ChunkK // 2
+    MFMAPerWarp: gl.constexpr = ChunkKPerStage // 16 // NumWarps
+
+    if IS_GFX1250:
+        FP8_K_DIM: gl.constexpr = 128 if HiddenDim > 64 else 64
+        if NumWarps == 1:
+            warp_bases: gl.constexpr = []
+        elif NumWarps == 2:
+            warp_bases: gl.constexpr = [[0, 1]]
+        elif NumWarps == 4:
+            warp_bases: gl.constexpr = [[0, 1], [0, 2]]
+        else:

+    batch_size,
+    Q_buffer,
+    stride_q_batch,
+    stride_q_heads,

+            (1,): [["tt.divisibility", 16], ["tt.pointer_range", 32]],  # Q_buffer
+            (2,): [["tt.divisibility", 16]],  # stride_q_batch
+            (3,): [["tt.divisibility", 16]],  # stride_q_heads
+            (4,): kv_cache_attr,  # KV_buffer
+            (5,): kv_cache_attr,  # stride_k_seq
+            (6,): kv_cache_attr,  # scale_buffer
+            (7,): kv_cache_attr,  # stride_scale_seq
+            (8,): [["tt.pointer_range", 32]],  # context_len_ptr
+            (9,): [["tt.pointer_range", 32]],  # kv_indices
+            (10,): [["tt.divisibility", 16], ["tt.pointer_range", 32]],  # weights
+            (11,): [["tt.divisibility", 16]],  # stride_w_batch
+        },
+    )
+    return triton.compile(src, target=target, options=options)
+
+
+# KV-split granularity multiplier (see SplitKV below). Swept on GLM-5.2 verify rows (48-84) once
+# the XCD-local program-id swizzle was in place: the optimum moves down from 32 to
+# 4-8 (median_ms 1:0.368, 2:0.322, 4:0.3033, 6:0.3030, 8:0.3044, 12:0.3103,
+# 16:0.3208, 24:0.3341, 32:0.3527, 48:0.3894) because the swizzle already fixes the
+# makespan imbalance that the fine split was papering over, and coarser pieces
+# amortize the per-piece prologue. SplitKV = 80 at mul=8 keeps grid % 8 == 0 for
+# any row count, which the swizzle needs.
+_SPLIT_MUL = 8
+
+# Occupancy hint passed to the Triton AMD backend, decoupled from `WavePerEU` (which
+# also feeds the SplitKV partition arithmetic -- changing that symbol would silently
+# move SplitKV off 80 and break the `rows*SplitKV % 8 == 0` XCD-swizzle guard).
+# The compiled kernel uses 92 VGPRs but the backend emits amdgpu-waves-per-eu="2,2"
+# and reserves 169, capping occupancy at 2 waves/SIMD with zero LDS in play.
+# Swept on GLM-5.2 verify rows (per-case ms, 48/60/72/84 rows): 2 -> .2482/.2467/.2941/.2956,
+# 3 -> .2304/.2289/.2673/.2743, 4 -> .2268/.2230/.2622/.2657, 5 -> .2305/.2227/
+# .2628/.2652. 4 is the knee; 6 would budget 512/6 = 85 < 92 VGPR and spill.

+# work-tile mapping). Groups are the TARGET_VERIFY siblings (6 consecutive rows); the
+# kernel ranks up to _LPT_NG2 groups. 0 disables (old split-major order).

+_LPT_GROUP_ROWS = 6
+_LPT_NG2 = 16

+# Sibling-pair fusion of phase 1 (_gluon_paged_mqa_logits_fused2). 0 disables.
+_FUSE = 1
+_FUSE_SPLITKV = 64
+_FUSE_WAVES_PER_EU = 3

+
+def gluon_fp8_paged_mqa_logits(
+    q_fp8: torch.Tensor,  # [batch, next_n, heads, hidden] fp8 e4m3fn
+    kv_cache,  # [num_pages, KVBlockSize, 1, hidden + 4] (preshuffled fp8 + fp32 scales per page)

+    out_logits: torch.Tensor,  # [batch * next_n, >= max_model_len] fp32
+    context_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_indices: torch.Tensor,
+    max_model_len: int,
+    Preshuffle: bool = False,
+    KVBlockSize: int = 1,
+    ChunkK: int = 256,
+    TotalCuCount: int | None = None,
+    WavePerEU: int = 2,
+):
+    if TotalCuCount is None:
+        TotalCuCount = get_num_sms()
+    batch_size, next_n, heads, hidden_dim = q_fp8.size()
+    _, block_Size, _, index_dim = kv_cache.size()
+    _, max_block_len = kv_indices.size()
+
+    TileQCount = batch_size * next_n
+    # Decouple KV split granularity from the waves_per_eu launch hint: the stock
+    # formula yields SplitKV = 10 for every batch size here, so every program starts
+    # at t=0 and the makespan equals the longest row (max/mean imbalance 1.8-2.4x).
+    # A finer split gives the scheduler smaller pieces to backfill with.
+    SplitKV = (max(1, TotalCuCount // TileQCount) + 4) // 5 * 5 * WavePerEU * _SPLIT_MUL
+
+    assert ChunkK % KVBlockSize == 0 or KVBlockSize % ChunkK == 0
+    assert block_Size == KVBlockSize
+    assert Preshuffle and KVBlockSize % 16 == 0
+
+    kv_cache = kv_cache.view(-1, KVBlockSize * index_dim)
+    num_block = kv_cache.shape[0]
+    kv_cache_fp8, kv_cache_scale = (
+        kv_cache[..., : KVBlockSize * hidden_dim],
+        kv_cache[..., KVBlockSize * hidden_dim :],
+    )
+    kv_cache_fp8 = kv_cache_fp8.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    kv_cache_scale = kv_cache_scale.view(torch.float32)
+
+    is_padded_mode = kv_cache_fp8.stride(0) % 16 == 0
+    nx = _NUM_XCD.value
+    if (
+        _FUSE
+        and next_n == 1
+        and heads == 32
+        and hidden_dim == 128
+        and KVBlockSize == 64
+        and ChunkK == 256
+        and get_cdna_version() == 4
+        and nx > 1
+        and _FUSE_SPLITKV % nx == 0
+        and batch_size % _LPT_GROUP_ROWS == 0
+        and batch_size // _LPT_GROUP_ROWS <= _LPT_NG2
+    ):
+        kernel = _compile_paged_mqa_logits_fused2(
+            heads,
+            ChunkK,
+            KVBlockSize,
+            hidden_dim,
+            is_padded_mode,
+            _FUSE_WAVES_PER_EU,
+            _LPT_GROUP_ROWS,
+            nx,
+        )
+        grid = (batch_size // 2 * _FUSE_SPLITKV, 1, 1)
+        kernel[grid](
+            batch_size,
+            q_fp8,
+            q_fp8.stride(0),
+            q_fp8.stride(2),
+            kv_cache_fp8,
+            kv_cache_fp8.stride(0),
+            kv_cache_scale,
+            kv_cache_scale.stride(0),
+            context_lens,
+            kv_indices,
+            weights,
+            weights.stride(0),
+            out_logits,
+            out_logits.stride(0),
+            max_model_len,
+            max_block_len,
+            _FUSE_SPLITKV,
+            heads,
+            ChunkK,
+            KVBlockSize,
+            hidden_dim,
+            _LPT_GROUP_ROWS,
+            _LPT_NG2,
+            nx,
+        )
+        return
+
+    grid = (batch_size * next_n * SplitKV, 1, 1)
+    lpt_group = 0
+    if (
+        _LPT
+        and next_n == 1
+        and _NUM_XCD.value > 1
+        and SplitKV % _NUM_XCD.value == 0
+        and batch_size % _LPT_GROUP_ROWS == 0
+        and batch_size // _LPT_GROUP_ROWS <= _LPT_NG2
+    ):
+        lpt_group = _LPT_GROUP_ROWS
+    kernel = _compile_deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits(
+        ChunkQ=heads,
+        ChunkK=ChunkK,
+        Preshuffle=Preshuffle,
+        KVBlockSize=KVBlockSize,
+        HiddenDim=hidden_dim,
+        is_padded_mode=is_padded_mode,
+        WavePerEU=WavePerEU,
+        WavesPerEuHint=_WAVES_PER_EU,
+        LptGroup=lpt_group,
+    )
+    cdna_version = get_cdna_version()
+    kernel[grid](
+        batch_size,
+        next_n,
+        heads,
+        q_fp8,
+        q_fp8.stride(0),
+        q_fp8.stride(1),
+        q_fp8.stride(2),
+        kv_cache_fp8,
+        kv_cache_fp8.stride(0),
+        kv_cache_scale,
+        kv_cache_scale.stride(0),
+        context_lens,
+        kv_indices,
+        weights,
+        weights.stride(0),
+        out_logits,
+        out_logits.stride(0),
+        max_model_len,
+        max_block_len,
+        num_block,
+        SplitKV,
+        # constexpr
+        heads,
+        ChunkK,
+        KVBlockSize,
+        hidden_dim,
+        cdna_version,
+        get_gfx(),
+        lpt_group,
+        _LPT_NG2,
+    )
+
+
+# Validated row range (decode and MTP-verify batches of one DP rank).
+MAX_ROWS = 128
+
+
+def supported(
+    q_fp8: torch.Tensor,
+    kv_cache_fp8: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    preshuffle: bool,
+    kv_block_size: int,
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether :func:`gluon_fp8_paged_mqa_logits` serves this call. ``q_fp8`` is
+    ``[rows, heads, dim]`` and ``kv_cache_fp8`` ``[num_pages, page, 1, dim + 4]``."""
+    return (
+        preshuffle
+        and kv_block_size == 64
+        and q_fp8.dim() == 3
+        and q_fp8.shape[1] == 32
+        and q_fp8.shape[2] == 128
+        and 1 <= q_fp8.shape[0] <= MAX_ROWS
+        and kv_cache_fp8.dim() == 4
+        and kv_cache_fp8.shape[1] == 64
+        and get_gfx() == "gfx950"
+    )

+"""The in-tree gfx950 paged MQA logits kernel against aiter's, on DSA decode /
+MTP-verify rows: same logits to fp32 rounding (the head sum is reordered) and
+the same top-2048 selection."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_amd_ci
+
+HEADS, DIM, PAGE, TOPK = 32, 128, 64, 2048
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+
+
+def _skip_reason():
+    if not torch.cuda.is_available():
+        return "no GPU"
+    arch = str(torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName).split(":")[0]
+    if arch != "gfx950":
+        return f"kernel is gfx950-only, got {arch}"
+    try:
+        from aiter.ops.cache import indexer_k_quant_and_cache  # noqa: F401
+        from aiter.ops.triton.pa_mqa_logits import (  # noqa: F401
+            deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits,
+        )
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa import (  # noqa: F401
+            gluon_paged_mqa_logits,
+        )
+    except ImportError as exc:  # pragma: no cover - build-environment dependent
+        return f"unavailable: {exc}"
+    return None
+
+
+SKIP = _skip_reason()
+
+# Same placement as test_dsa_gfx950_fused_indexer.py: a gfx950 suite.
+register_amd_ci(est_time=120, suite="stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd-mi35x")
+
+
+@unittest.skipIf(SKIP is not None, SKIP or "")
+class TestGluonPagedMqaLogits(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        from aiter.ops.cache import indexer_k_quant_and_cache
+        from aiter.ops.triton.pa_mqa_logits import deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits
+
+        from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.dsa import gluon_paged_mqa_logits
+
+        cls.ref_fn = staticmethod(deepgemm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits)
+        cls.mod = gluon_paged_mqa_logits
+        cls.dev = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+        # Index-K pool written by the production writer (preshuffled, ue8m0).
+        cls.num_pages = 8192
+        g = torch.Generator(device=cls.dev).manual_seed(0)
+        k = torch.randn(cls.num_pages * PAGE, DIM, device=cls.dev, generator=g).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        pool = torch.zeros(
+            cls.num_pages, PAGE * (DIM + 4), dtype=torch.uint8, device=cls.dev
+        )
+        indexer_k_quant_and_cache(
+            k,
+            pool.view(-1, PAGE, DIM + 4).view(FP8),
+            torch.arange(cls.num_pages * PAGE, device=cls.dev),
+            DIM,
+            "ue8m0",
+            preshuffle=True,
+        )
+        cls.kv = pool.view(cls.num_pages, PAGE, 1, DIM + 4).view(FP8)
+
+    def _case(self, lens, rows_per_request, share, width):
+        """Rows grouped ``rows_per_request`` per request with lengths L+1..L+r; with
+        ``share`` the rows of a request use one page table (MTP verify)."""
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(sum(lens) + width)
+        rows = len(lens) * rows_per_request
+        pt = torch.zeros(rows, width, dtype=torch.int32)
+        seq = torch.empty(rows, dtype=torch.int32)
+        for i, L in enumerate(lens):
+            npg = -(-(L + rows_per_request) // PAGE)
+            base = torch.randperm(self.num_pages, generator=g)[:npg].int()
+            for j in range(rows_per_request):
+                r = i * rows_per_request + j
+                pt[r, :npg] = (
+                    base
+                    if share
+                    else torch.randperm(self.num_pages, generator=g)[:npg].int()
+                )
+                seq[r] = L + j + 1
+        q = torch.randn(rows, HEADS, DIM, generator=g).clamp_(-4, 4).to(FP8)
+        w = torch.randn(rows, HEADS, generator=g) * HEADS**-0.5
+        return q.to(self.dev), w.to(self.dev), seq.to(self.dev), pt.to(self.dev)
+
+    def _logits(self, fn, q, w, seq, pt):
+        out = torch.full(
+            (q.shape[0], pt.shape[1] * PAGE), float("-inf"), device=self.dev
+        )
+        fn(
+            q.unsqueeze(1),
+            self.kv,
+            w,
+            out,
+            seq,
+            pt,
+            out.shape[1],
+            Preshuffle=True,
+            KVBlockSize=PAGE,
+        )
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        return out
+
+    def _assert_matches_aiter(self, lens, rows_per_request=6, share=True, width=4096):
+        q, w, seq, pt = self._case(lens, rows_per_request, share, width)
+        self.assertTrue(
+            self.mod.supported(q, self.kv, preshuffle=True, kv_block_size=PAGE)
+        )
+        ref = self._logits(self.ref_fn, q, w, seq, pt)
+        got = self._logits(self.mod.gluon_fp8_paged_mqa_logits, q, w, seq, pt)
+        for r in range(q.shape[0]):
+            n = int(seq[r])
+            torch.testing.assert_close(
+                got[r, :n], ref[r, :n], rtol=1e-5, atol=1e-5, msg=f"row {r}"
+            )
+            if n > TOPK:
+                # Logits differ only by rounding, so the top-k selections may only
+                # differ among elements within that rounding of the k-th score.
+                eps = 1e-4
+                kth = torch.topk(ref[r, :n], TOPK).values[-1]
+                sel = torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.bool, device=self.dev)
+                sel[torch.topk(got[r, :n], TOPK).indices] = True
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    bool(sel[ref[r, :n] > kth + eps].all()),
+                    f"row {r}: a clear top-k member was not selected",
+                )
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    bool((ref[r, :n][sel] >= kth - eps).all()),
+                    f"row {r}: selected an element clearly below the k-th",
+                )
+
+    def test_verify_rows_shared_tables(self):
+        for lens in (
+            [100_000] * 8,
+            [3000, 50_000, 120_000, 200_000, 9000, 60_000, 130_000, 70_000],
+            [250_000] * 14,
+            [40_000] * 21,
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(n=len(lens), lens=lens[:3]):
+                self._assert_matches_aiter(lens)
+
+    def test_rows_without_shared_tables(self):
+        """Paired rows whose page tables differ: the fused pair kernel must fall
+        back to scoring them separately."""
+        self._assert_matches_aiter([60_000] * 8, share=False)
+
+    def test_plain_decode_rows(self):
+        for n in (1, 7, 48, 100, 128):
+            with self.subTest(rows=n):
+                self._assert_matches_aiter(
+                    [30_000 + 997 * i for i in range(n)], rows_per_request=1
+                )
+
+    def test_supported_bounds(self):
+        q = torch.empty(129, HEADS, DIM, dtype=FP8, device=self.dev)
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self.mod.supported(q, self.kv, preshuffle=True, kv_block_size=PAGE)
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            self.mod.supported(q[:8], self.kv, preshuffle=False, kv_block_size=PAGE)
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
